interpretations: For each account that has at least one order, return its account ID, its branch district’s region (`A3`), its order count, and that count minus the unrounded average order count across all accounts with orders; sort by the difference descending and include the top 10 accounts and all ties at the 10th-place difference
queries:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS position
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT r.account_id, d.A3, r.order_count, r.difference
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE r.position <= 10
ORDER BY r.difference DESC, r.account_id
